ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity values (black/dark grey base) with sparse, high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approximately 5-8% of total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark base across both lobes. Distal tips exhibit dense, irregular high-intensity white clusters (barnacles). Surface area populated with stochastic high-contrast white focal spots of varying radii (1-5 pixels).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree internal angle, located at the central vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes of 2-8 pixels concentrated along the outer thirds of the trailing edge; central portions adjacent to the notch exhibit smoother linear boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips, forming a wide 'U' profile relative to the waterline.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of circular white pixel clusters across both lobes, with a higher density of larger clusters on the lateral-central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent, high-contrast diagonal linear mark visible on the left lobe (viewer's left), oriented approximately 45 degrees relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, calcified barnacle clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, creating high-relief, irregular white-and-beige textures against the dark fluke edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive ring-shaped white scars (likely lamprey or barnacle attachment sites) visible on the right lobe (viewer's right) near the mid-section.
